## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 juil. 2026 - 10 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _AJey Calloway_, 18 juil. 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
            2. _Zachary Bohannon_, 13 juil. 2026, 1/5: "awful designed app i literally cannot log in to the app it's so broken"
            3. _Emily Foster_, 10 juil. 2026, 1/5: "horrible service requires close to 100 bucks just to cancel any membership and workers are rude. Even after you pay the membership they take another payment for what the "last month" would be even if you don't go anymore. there cleaner and nicer places to go for free with kind workers than this place app can also lag a lot and not work for up to 20-25 min never again"
<!--/ir-theme-->
